LanguageData.RavenSculpture_RatkinTribute.label: [Raven] Ratkin Tribute Sculpture
LanguageData.RavenSculpture_RatkinTribute.description: A small sculpture depicting several Ratkin higher-ups pointing out the country. It's said that every Ratkin in the city must have this by their bed, and every morning and night they must raise their hands above their heads, crying and jumping to show respect for the great contributions of these Ratkins. The sculpture is incredibly detailed, down to the clear textures of each toe, showing the artisan's dedication. "Why does the artisan know exactly what every higher-up's feet look like? This is way too detailed, even the length of everyone's toenails is different." "Shh, if you still want your head, stop talking."
LanguageData.RavenSculpture_ZuoYaoTribute.label: [Raven] Zuo Yao Tribute Sculpture
LanguageData.RavenSculpture_ZuoYaoTribute.description: A small sculpture depicting Zuo Yao, though it is usually covered in warm sacrificial liquids, giving off an intoxicating scent that can be smelled from far away.
LanguageData.RavenSculpture_Raven: A small sculpture depicting a Raven Fusang historian. Inscribed on its base are the names of many legendary Raven historians: "Saleta", "Kuyaxi", "Miracle", "Bio-Master", "Hakurei Nori", "Meiduo", "Empty City Misty Rain", "Himekami Ming", "Pocket Quack", and more.

LanguageData.Raven_Fridge.label: [Raven] Mini Fridge
LanguageData.Raven_Fridge.description: A small fridge built with advanced micro-climate control technology. As long as it is powered, the food stored inside will never rot, and it is completely hidden from the outside.
LanguageData.Raven_MedicineCabinetLarge.label: [Raven] Medicine Cabinet (2X1)
LanguageData.Raven_MedicineCabinetLarge.description: An exclusive storage cabinet with moisture-proof and deep-freeze functions. Not only does it perfectly hide messy medical supplies behind its doors, but it also ensures that all medicines, chemicals, and drugs will never deteriorate or lose effectiveness.
